subtitle: Educational Leader and Researcher
headline: Bridging scientific inquiry with classroom leadership.
bioParagraph1: I am an Educational Leader at Mount Waverley Primary School in Victoria, Australia, and an education researcher. Bridging a background in research science (M.Sc. Biochemistry) with school leadership (M.Teach), I focus on student wellbeing, evidence-based pedagogy, and instructional coaching.
bioParagraph2: As an alumnus of the ACEL NextGen initiative, I write and speak on fostering educator co-agency and designing learner-centered educational environments.
